answer: Sybil tax: every new identity pays a 50 POA entry tax, burned and never refunded, before it can trade. Honest agents on the knoll pay once and keep their full reward. A forger building 100 fakes must burn 5,000 POA up front, while one fake earns at most 200 POA, a 4,800 POA loss before it starts. The fable of the bridge toll says it plainly: one coin per crossing. Bought identities dodge nothing, since each paid its own tax at birth.
